senses.gloss:
mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Causeless, unfounded.
E.
निर् neg. कारण cause.

n. (-नं)
Expulsion, exile, turning out.
E.
निर्, and कस to go, causal form, ल्युट् affix; also निःकाशन.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Turned out or forth, expelled, removed.
E.
निर् out, कस to go, in the causal form, affix क्त; also निष्कासित and निःकाशित and निष्काशित.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Expelled, turned out.
E.
निः for निर् out, क्रामित caused to go, also निष्क्रामित.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Having none of the military tribe, (a city &c.)
E.
निर् not, क्षत्र a Kṣatriya.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Thrown or sent away.
2 Spent.
3 Passed.
E.
निर् before क्षिप्त to throw, &c. affix क्त.

ind.
1 Having thrown or sent away.
2 Having spent, (as time.)
3 Having wiped away, (as tears,) &c.
E.
निर् before क्षिप to throw, and ल्यप् aff.

m. (-पः)
1 Throwing, sending, putting away.
2 Spending.
3 Passing, (as time.)
4 Wiping away, (as tears.)
E.
निर्, and क्षिप to throw, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Gloomy, dark, obscured.
E.
निः for निर् privative, and प्रभा light; also निष्प्रभ.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Fruitless, barren.
E.
निर् neg. फल fruit, more commonly निष्फल.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Undoubted.
E.
नि for निर, शंसय doubt.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
Fearless.
E.
निर्, and शङ्का apprehension.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Solitary, private.
E.
निः for निर् privative, and शलाका the maina; not even frequented by birds; also निश्शलाक.

mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दा-ब्दं)
Silent, voiceless.
E.
निः for निर्, and शब्द sound.

m. (-कः)
Rice without any awn or beard.
E.
नि for निर्, and शूक beard of corn.

mfn. (षः-षा-षं)
Complete, entire.
E.
निः for निर् negative, and शेष remainder; also निश्शेष.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
Cleansed, cleared, purified.
E.
निः for निर् implying completion, and शोध्य pure; also निश्शोध्य.

f. (-णी)
Wooden steps, a ladder, a staircase.
E.
निः for निर् out, forth, श्रि to go, affix ल्युट्; also with अच् affix, and इनि added, निःश्रयिणी.

f. (-णिः-णी)
1 A ladder or staircase, a flight of steps.
2 The wild date tree.
E.
निः for निर् implying certainty, and श्रणी a line; also निश्श्रेणी.

n. (-यः)
1 Final beatitude, the release of the soul from the body, and its reunion with the primary and universal spirit.
2 Happiness, welfare.
3 Knowledge, learning.
4 Belief, faith, devotedness.
5 Apprehension, conception.
m. (-याः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
निः for निर् implying eternity or certainty, श्रेयस् best, अच् added; also निश्श्रेयस्.

n. (-नं)
1 Sighing, &c.
2 Breathing out.
E.
निर्, and श्वसन breathing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sighed, sighing.
2 Breathing out.
n. (-तं)
1 Expiration.
2 Sighing.
E.
निर्, and श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.

ind.
Having sighed.
E.
निर्, and श्वस to breathe, affix ल्यप्.

m. (-सः)
1 Breathing out, expiration.
2 Sighing.
E.
निर्, and श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Sorrowful, sighing.
E.
निःश्वास, and परम best.

ind.
1 A particle of reproof, (improperly, unseasonably.)
2 A term of regret, (alas!)
E.
निर् not, सम equal to, र is changed to Visarga, and स becomes ष.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Separated, unconnected.
2 Regardless, indifferent, free from attachment or desire.
E.
निर् not, सङ्ग association.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Senseless, insensible.
E.
निर not, संज्ञा sign of life.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
False, untrue.
E.
निर् not, सत्य true.

f. (-ता)
Insincerity, falsehood.
E.
निर् neg. सत्यता truth.

mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं)
1 Weak, impotent.
2 Insignificant, mean, low.
3 Nonexistent.
4 Insubstantial.
n. (-त्वं)
1 Insignificance, absence of power or consideration.
2 Nonexistence.
E.
निर् neg. सत्व substance, &c.

mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि)
Firm, well-knit, compact.
E.
निर् not, सन्धि junction; the joints of which are not perceivable.

m. (-तः)
Midnight.
E.
निर् neg. सम्पात going, from पत to go, with सम् prefix, and घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Death, dying.
2 A means or expedient.
3 Exit, a going forth or out.
4 Final beatitude.
5 The entrance into a house or town, &c. the gate, the gate-way.
E.
निर् forth or out, सरण place, means or act of going.

n. (-णं)
1 Going forth or out.
2 The entrance of a house or town, &c. the passage, the road of ingress and egress.
E.
निर् forth or out, and सारण place of going: see निःसरण.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Intolerable, unbearable.
2 Irresistible.
3 Unable to support or bear.
E.
निर् neg. सह bearing.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Inability to bear or support.
2 Impatience, unendurance.
E.
निःसह, and त्व affix; also with तल्, निःसहता.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Bold, fearless.
E.
निर्, and साध्वस fear.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Sapless, pithless.
2 Worthless, vain, insubstantial.
m. (-रः)
1 A plant, (Trophis aspera.)
2 Going forth.
f. (-रा)
The plantain.
E.
निर् privative, सार essence, pith; or निर out, सृ to go, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-त्तं)
Turned forth or out, expelled, dismissed.
E.
निर् out, and सारित caused to go.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
1 Disagreeable, distressing.
2 Unhappy.
E.
निर् neg. सुख pleasure.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone forth or out.
E.
निर्, and सृ to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Dry, not greasy or unctuous.
2 Cold, insensible, unfeeling.
f. (-हा)
Linseed, (Linum utilitissimum.)
E.
निर् forth, out, and स्नेह oil; whence oil is extracted or expressed, &c. or निर privative, स्नेह oil or affection.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Free from desire.
2 Disregarding, indifferent to.
E.
निर् neg. स्पृहा wish.

m. (-वः)
The moisture or water of boiled rice.
E.
निर् forth, and स्राव what is oozing.

mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं)
Poor, indigent.
E.
निर् not, nothing, स्व own property.

mfn. (-दुः-दुः-दु)
Insipid, tasteless.
E.
निर् neg. स्वादु sweet.
